provenance_resolution.problem: Older local configuration archives include deployment fingerprints but do not include matching firmware or native binaries, so applying fingerprints would falsify active code provenance.
provenance_resolution.implementation: Broker filters exact opt/InstantLinkBridge/.deployment and its subtree from applied plan entries; original manifest and full archive remain verified both during planning and execution. Generic temporary-root restore primitive remains unchanged.
provenance_resolution.tests: Existing current metadata remains byte-identical; absent metadata remains absent; config and selected bond/adapter identity still restore. Individually tampered skipped metadata is rejected before service stop or mutation even after aggregate archive digest is recomputed. Returned restored_count and restored_paths describe applied files only.

ownership_resolution_retained: Product config files remain runtime-owned while preserving private0600; full product ancestor repair preserves traversal. Root BlueZ and other OS files unchanged.
